spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive/setCameraActive operations and classifies the real return value; the 'new shape' verdict requires a Promise ([[Class]] tag) that fulfils with exactly undefined.

interactive.rationale: Four call buttons + run-all + clear; each produces a result card (typeof, instanceof, tag, thenable, settle state, timing) and a verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the dissected return value and an honest 'not a promise' on 158; the page does exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles missing methods, synchronous throws and unexpected settle values; cross-realm and rejection cases are deferred to the not-fully-active concept by design.

conformance.rationale: Same contracts as set-*-returns-promise and fully-active-resolves-undefined in the feature suite (fail on Chrome 153, pass under the shim).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified with headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP verification). Chrome 153 has the OLD shape; the new-shape branches were exercised only with a test-only init-script shim in the harness (never shipped). Default: every call reported typeof undefined / [object Undefined] / not-a-promise and the legacy verdict; shim: Promise fulfilled with undefined in ~0.1-0.2 ms. Zero console errors/page errors/failed requests both modes.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5188639100370944 plus the spec section and MDN/WebIDL/HTML references relevant to this concept.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (bg-paper/stone/ivory, text-charcoal/black/muted, accent-emerald-dark/rose/blue/amber-as-border-only); every button override sets both background and color; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons named by their visible call text; verdict is aria-live polite; result cards are an ordered list with dt/dd pairs so screen readers get field names; code sample focusable.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360x740 (DPR 3, touch, isMobile) and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow on both, button rows wrap, 44px targets, screenshots read for both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: demo-telemetry.js loaded; showcaseTelemetry.assert fires for the primary contract and for the legacy/fallback branch with the raw shape/state as details.

openQuestions.title: Capture the real Chrome 159 run
openQuestions.detail: Re-run on Chrome 159+ (or Safari 18.4+) without the shim and record the actual settle timing; Chromium's ToResolvedUndefinedPromise should settle in a microtask.

openQuestions.title: Report setScreenshareActive when Chromium adds it
openQuestions.detail: The spec defines setScreenshareActive(); the env readout reports its presence. If Chromium adds it, consider adding a call button for it.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for asynchronous result announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live=polite for standard result/status updates; reserve assertive for critical interruptions; avoid announcing interstitial 'loading' noise.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/readouts are aria-live polite; per-call result cards and logs are NOT live (they are navigable on demand) to avoid spam.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button aria-pressed mute microphone camera
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Communicate toggle state with aria-pressed, style :focus-visible, keep targets >=24px (bumped on coarse pointers).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons min-height 44px with :focus-visible outline in --accent-blue; toggles (call page) expose aria-pressed and aria-busy while awaiting.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: flex-wrap:wrap on button rows, min-inline-size:0 on items holding long strings, auto-fit/minmax grids, never mask overflow with overflow:hidden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Button groups wrap; result grids use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%,Npx),1fr)); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800.

summary: A direct, honest return-shape probe: on Chrome 153 it says 'undefined, not a promise' and on the new shape it says 'Promise fulfilled with undefined', never inferring support from method presence.
